data.narrative:
Vannevar Labs, a Series B-stage Defense & Security company founded by Brett Granberg and Nini Moorhead, has raised $90M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 publicly traded (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms at the same stage, including Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, and Twenty.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy baseline of $90M and applying a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, implies a valuation of $171M. Peer-median analysis across the 8 same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The divergence reflects substantial dispersion in the Defense & Security peer set.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $145M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $648M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer multiples establish the upper bound. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to the peer cohort, differentiation within a dispersed comp set, and whether Vannevar's product-market fit has progressed beyond typical Series B maturity. Resolution of these factors will determine positioning within this wide range.
